qualification.details: As per SRO norms, candidates must hold Matriculation plus a National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the relevant trade, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT).

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly wage as per current CPC Level-1 basic pay, plus Dearness Allowance (DA) as per government rules. Remuneration for an 8-hour working day is calculated at 1/30th of the basic pay + DA of the relevant pay scale, with proportional deduction for unauthorised absence. A 3% annual increment in basic pay is admissible subject to satisfactory performance, reviewed on a half-yearly basis. House Rent Allowance is payable if AWEIL does not provide quarters. Selected candidates are also eligible for EPF and are covered under the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923.

selection_process: Selection for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026 is purely on merit
Candidates are shortlisted for the Trade Test/Practical Test based on a cut-off percentage decided by AWTM
using total marks obtained in the NCVT trade examination. The Trade Test/Practical Test is conducted by AWTM
Ichapur. The final merit list is prepared from combined marks in the NCVT examination and the Trade Test/Practical Test
weighted 80% (NCVT) and 20% (Trade Test/Practical). Qualified candidates are called for Document Verification in merit order
limited to the number of notified vacancies by trade/category. If candidates are rejected at Document Verification for incomplete documents or not meeting age/qualification norms

additional candidates are called in merit order to fill the gap. The ratio of eligible candidates called (for document verification/interview stage) to notified vacancies is 1:10. In case of a tie in marks
preference is given in this order: (i) prior trade apprentice of GSF Kashipur
(ii) prior trade apprentice of other Ordnance Factories
(iv) older date of birth. Selected candidates must undergo a medical fitness test before appointment.
how_to_apply: Download the application form from aweil.in/notice and take a printout.
Fill the form in Block Letters only, and read the detailed terms and conditions carefully.
Attach self-certified copies of required documents, including educational qualification certificates as proof of age, and two additional self-attested photographs (self-signed on the back).
OBC candidates must also submit a duly signed Undertaking as per Appendix-1 of the application form.
Superscribe the envelope clearly: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF 'Trade Name' ON CONTRACT BASIS".
Send the completed application by post to: The Chief General Manager, Academy of Weapon Technology & Management, Ichapur, P.O.- Ichapur, Nawabganj, Dist. – 24 Parganas(N), PIN – 743144.
Ensure the application reaches within the last date, i.e. 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News.

content_sections.heading: GSF Kashipur Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026 carries 40 total vacancies across six technical trades, with category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) break-up as notified. The document also specifies horizontal reservation for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates, without separately break-up figures by trade.

content_sections.heading: GSF Kashipur Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly wage as per current CPC Level-1 basic pay, plus Dearness Allowance (DA) as per government rules. Remuneration for an 8-hour working day is calculated at 1/30th of the basic pay + DA of the relevant pay scale, with proportional deduction for unauthorised absence. A 3% annual increment in basic pay is admissible subject to satisfactory performance, reviewed on a half-yearly basis. House Rent Allowance is payable if AWEIL does not provide quarters. Selected candidates are also eligible for EPF and are covered under the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923.

content_sections.heading: GSF Kashipur Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee is payable by Demand Draft in favour of "Ordnance Factories Institute of Learning, Ishapore."

content_sections.heading: GSF Kashipur Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026 is purely on merit, based on the following process: Candidates are shortlisted for the Trade Test/Practical Test based on a cut-off percentage decided by AWTM, Ichapur, using total marks obtained in the NCVT trade examination. The Trade Test/Practical Test is conducted by AWTM, Ichapur. The final merit list is prepared from combined marks in the NCVT examination and the Trade Test/Practical Test, weighted 80% (NCVT) and 20% (Trade Test/Practical). Qualified candidates are called for Document Verification in merit order, limited to the number of notified vacancies by trade/category. If candidates are rejected at Document Verification for incomplete documents or not meeting age/qualification norms, additional candidates are called in merit order to fill the gap. The ratio of eligible candidates called (for document verification/interview stage) to notified vacancies is 1:10. In case of a tie in marks, preference is given in this order: (i) prior trade apprentice of GSF Kashipur, (ii) prior trade apprentice of other Ordnance Factories, (iii) higher marks in NCVT, (iv) older date of birth. Selected candidates must undergo a medical fitness test before appointment.

faq.question: Q1. What is GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by AWTM Ichapur (a unit of AWEIL, Ministry of Defence) for 40 tenure-based, contractual Technical trade posts at Gun & Shell Factory, Kashipur, under Advertisement No. 01/Hiring-GSF/AWTM/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 40 vacancies across six trades: Electrical Fitter (4), Mechanical Fitter (14), Machinist (6), Turner (7), Electroplater (6), and Heat Treatment Operator (3).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 30 days from the date this advertisement is published in Employment News. 07 October 2026

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Matriculation plus an NCVT-issued National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the relevant trade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18 to 35 years for general candidates, with age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, Ex-Servicemen, and PwD candidates as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 100, payable by Demand Draft in favour of "Ordnance Factories Institute of Learning, Ishapore." SC/ST, Ex-Servicemen, and PwD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By downloading and filling the application form from aweil.in/notice and sending it by post to the Chief General Manager, AWTM, Ichapur - applications are accepted offline only.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GSF Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Merit-based selection using NCVT examination marks (80% weightage) and Trade Test/Practical Test marks (20% weightage), followed by Document Verification and a Medical Fitness Test.
